app.name: PureMail
app.description: Modern email with thread-linked tasks, follow-ups, and right-pane work tracking.

help.says: Shows your mail searched for those words. On its own, it shows your inbox.
help.wont: Doesn’t send or change any mail.

help.says: Opens that person’s latest thread, ready for you to write.
help.wont: Doesn’t send anything. You press Send yourself.

tools.name: fn_inboxBriefing
tools.description: One-shot executive inbox briefing. Replaces calling getMailContext + multiple listThreads + getThread calls. Returns unread/priority/VIP counts, threads awaiting your reply, overdue follow-ups, unscreened Screener senders, ready drafts, and concise previews with security highlights.

limit.description: Maximum actionable threads to include in detail (default 10, max 25).

includeNoise.description: Include newsletters/receipts in the top thread list (default false).

tools.name: fn_triageInbox
tools.description: Batch-categorizes untriaged inbox threads into needs_reply / important / fyi / noise in ONE call, using configured Decision Models (Jex / OpenAI / Local) when Automatic Triage is active and deterministic signals otherwise. Flags phishing risks. Pass apply: true to save the verdicts onto the threads (does not move or send mail).

limit.description: Maximum untriaged threads to evaluate (default 10, max 20).

apply.description: Record the computed verdicts onto the threads (default false: preview plan only).

tools.name: fn_followUpSweep
tools.description: Finds sent threads awaiting a reply and due follow-up reminders in ONE call. Uses Decision Models (when active) to filter out closing "Thanks!" messages that do not actually expect a reply, and generates ready-to-use follow-up nudge text. Optionally schedules reminders for overdue unanswered threads when scheduleMissing: true.

limit.description: Maximum awaiting threads to return (default 15, max 30).

scheduleMissing.description: Schedule a follow-up reminder for awaiting threads that lack one (default false).

tools.name: fn_senderDossier
tools.description: Builds a complete dossier on a sender (email address or domain) in ONE call: relationship metrics, VIP/Screener status, recent threads with previews, shared attachments, linked tasks, and kept reading-room context.

limit.description: Maximum recent threads to include (default 10, max 25).

tools.name: fn_prepareReply
tools.description: Prepares a reply draft for a thread in ONE call: loads thread & sender context, matches saved snippets, and stages a ready-to-review draft (when body or snippetId is provided, or returns prepared context + snippet candidates). NEVER sends email — a person always clicks Send.

body.description: Optional reply body to stage immediately as a draft.

snippetId.description: Optional saved snippet id or shortcut to render into the reply body.

brief.description: Optional one-line intent/guidance for preparing the reply.

tools.name: fn_cleanupPromotions
tools.description: Finds bulk newsletters, promotions, and List-Unsubscribe clutter in the inbox. Runs read-only preview by default (apply: false); pass apply: true to archive, mark read, or trash ONLY the exact matched promotional threads and optionally add an auto-archive filter.

query.description: Optional mail query to scope cleanup (default: inbox newsletters/bulk with List-Unsubscribe).

action.description: Cleanup action when apply is true (default "archive").

apply.description: Execute the cleanup on the matched promotional threads (default false: read-only preview).

createAutoArchiveFilterFrom.description: Optional sender email or domain to auto-file into a Newsletters filter (only when apply: true).

tools.name: fn_screenerReview
tools.description: Reviews first-time unknown senders waiting in The Screener with deterministic + Decision-Model routing suggestions (inbox, feed, paper_trail, blocked). Optionally applies a batch of user-approved decisions in ONE call (escalates to destructive approval when decisions are supplied, since blocked senders move mail to Trash).

limit.description: Maximum unscreened senders to return (default 15, max 30).

decisions.description: Optional user-approved Screener decisions to apply in one batch.

tools.name: fn_auditThreadSecurity
tools.description: Runs a complete privacy & security audit on a thread in ONE call: SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, From vs Reply-To/Return-Path domain alignment, blocked tracking pixels (vendors + URLs), suspicious/phishing link detection, AND Decision-Model semantic deception/credential-harvesting analysis when active.

tools.name: fn_exportThreadBundle
tools.description: Exports a thread bundle in ONE call: saves the thread PDF and/or document attachments into the workspace Mail folder (when workspace saving is available) and returns a clean Markdown transcript + metadata.

savePdf.description: Save thread as PDF in the workspace Mail folder (default true when supported).

saveAttachments.description: Save thread attachments into the workspace Mail folder (default true when supported).

includeMarkdown.description: Include a Markdown digest of the thread in the response (default true).

tools.name: getMailContext
tools.description: Return the selected account, the query the mail list is currently showing, its result count, and the selected thread. Includes workspaceFolder, the absolute path of the user's workspace; saveAttachments and saveMessageAsPdf write into its Mail folder.

tools.name: listThreads
tools.description: List mail threads matching a query. Query syntax is the same string the user types in the search box: in:inbox from:x subject:y label:"z" is:unread|read|starred|snoozed|important|other|triaged|untriaged triage:needs_reply|important|fyi|noise has:attachment|calendar before:/after:YYYY-MM-DD older_than:30d newer_than:7d sort:newest|oldest|sender|subject limit:N, and any operator may be negated with a leading '-'. Returns the canonical query, the total match count, and the threads.

query.description: Query string. Empty means every thread in the account inside the fetch window, excluding Trash.

tools.name: searchAllMail
tools.description: Search ALL of the user’s mail on the server — not limited to the locally synced window. Works on Gmail (Gmail search syntax verbatim: from:, before:, older_than:, has:attachment …) and on IMAP accounts such as Proton Mail via Bridge (plain-text search across every folder). On Gmail, out-of-window results can be imported with getThread; on IMAP they cannot — relay their details directly.

query.description: Gmail search syntax, sent to Gmail verbatim.

tools.name: getThread
tools.description: Read one thread: its subject, participants, labels, status and messages. Each message lists its attachments with their name, type (PDF, Doc, Sheet, Slides, Text, Image…), size and whether it is a document — saveAttachments saves them as files.

includeBodies.description: Include full message bodies rather than snippets.

tools.name: showQuery
tools.description: Point the user's mail list at this query so they can read exactly what you are working with. Use before applying a bulk action so the user sees the affected set.

tools.name: applyMailAction
tools.description: Apply a bulk action over the threads matching a query, immediately: archive, trash, read, unread, label, snooze, move, star, or unstar. The affected query is shown in the user's list and the change is recorded in the mail log. Destructive actions (trash) only at the user's direction.

snoozedUntil.description: ISO timestamp; required when action is 'snooze'.

rationale.description: One line explaining why, shown to the user.

mailboxName.description: Required when action is "move": the mailbox name or id to move the threads to.

tools.name: markThreadsRead
tools.description: Mark specific threads read or unread by id. applyMailAction covers a whole query; this names threads. Applied immediately, synced to the account in the background, and recorded in the mail log. Threads already in the requested state are left alone and listed as alreadyThere.

threadIds.description: Thread ids from listThreads, searchAllMail or getThread.

read.description: false marks the threads unread; true marks them read.

tools.name: composeMessage
tools.description: Compose a NEW outgoing message (its own thread in Drafts), not a reply to an existing thread. Use draftReply to answer a conversation. Pass `attachments` (absolute file paths) to attach documents in the same call — they are read and checked against the 25 MB sending limit before the draft is made, so a refused file leaves nothing behind. Drafts never send themselves.

to.description: Recipients, comma-separated. Accepts "Name <email>" or a bare address.

body.description: The message text you have written for the user to review.

attachments.description: Optional absolute paths of files to attach (e.g. /Users/developer/Pure/Reports/q3.pdf). Relative paths are refused.

tools.name: updateDraft
tools.description: Rewrite an existing unsent draft. Read getDraft first and provide its version as expectedVersion to reject concurrent edits.

expectedVersion.description: Exact version returned by getDraft. Required to prevent overwriting concurrent edits.

tools.name: sendDraft
tools.description: Send ONE prepared draft, exactly as it is now, through the normal send path. A release action: only a person can send, by pressing Send in PureMail, or by approving it in the Executive team (its Send it? card), which then carries out exactly that send once. A second approval reports the attempt already under way; a conflicted or unconfirmed draft is refused. Its answer says queued until the mail service confirms, and delivery gives the reading (held, submitting, submitted). An agent cannot call this at any trust level; leave the draft and tell the person it is ready.

draftId.description: The draft to send, as getDraft or the executive share's state file names it.

version.description: getDraft's version token for the text the person approved. When it no longer matches, nothing is sent.

tools.name: createMailTask
tools.description: Create a task linked to a mail thread.

tools.name: openThread
tools.description: Open one thread in the user’s reader. Ask the user in chat FIRST — this moves their screen. For several results, prefer showQuery.

tools.name: sendRunItem
tools.description: Send ONE run item — the current one, or the one named by draftId/row — through the normal send path. A release action: only a person can send, by pressing Send & next in PureMail, or by approving it as CEO in the Executive team, which then carries out exactly that send once. An agent cannot call this at any trust level; open the run with resumeRun and tell the person it is ready.

runId.description: The run's id, from listRuns or getMailContext.activeRuns.

draftId.description: The item's draft id (as getRun lists it). Omit both draftId and row to mean the item the run is currently on.

row.description: The item's 1-based recipient row (as getRun lists it). Alternative to draftId.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PureMail's extended specialist tools (53 tools across archive_sweep, audit, boxes, documents, drafts, filters, reading_room, send_runs, triage, views) and composite functions (9 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "archive_sweep", "audit", "boxes", "documents", "drafts").

category.description: Optional category filter (archive_sweep, audit, boxes, documents, drafts, filters, reading_room, send_runs, triage, views, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PureMail's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: archive_sweep, audit, boxes, documents, drafts, filters, reading_room, send_runs, triage, views). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PureMail's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: archive_sweep, audit, boxes, documents, drafts, filters, reading_room, send_runs, triage, views). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools (call sendDraft / sendRunItem directly).

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
